answer: Sybil tax stops mass fake identities. Each identity burns one 60-credit opal token every epoch. The burn receipt is posted on a public terrace ledger, and an identity without a fresh burn is cut off. At the ridge checkpoint, a rented receipt fails because each burn is keyed to one identity. A forger with 1,000 fakes burns 60,000 credits each epoch against a 40,000 pool, losing 20,000 per epoch. An honest agent burns one token and keeps its share.
